entries.title: Psalms 67:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm. A Song.>> God be merciful to us and bless us, [And] cause His face to shine upon us. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 67:2
segments: That Your way may be known on earth, Your salvation among all nations.

entries.title: Psalms 67:3
segments: Let the peoples praise You, O God; Let all the peoples praise You.

entries.title: Psalms 67:4
segments: Oh, let the nations be glad and sing for joy! For You shall judge the people righteously, And govern the nations on earth. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 67:5
segments: Let the peoples praise You, O God; Let all the peoples praise You.

entries.title: Psalms 67:6
segments: [Then] the earth shall yield her increase; God, our own God, shall bless us.

entries.title: Psalms 67:7
segments: God shall bless us, And all the ends of the earth shall fear Him.
